cover_letter:
Dear AppCritica Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Content & SEO Specialist position, as advertised on your career page. AppCritica's commitment to "shaping the future of AI & Technology" and building a transparent tech ecosystem deeply resonates with my professional aspirations and recent experience. My background in digital marketing, particularly in SEO, content optimization, and web development, aligns precisely with the role’s requirements to "write, optimize, and manage content that drives traffic and builds trust."

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on expertise in managing the full lifecycle of on-page SEO, from comprehensive keyword research to publishing keyword-targeted blog content for client websites. This has consistently improved organic visibility and search rankings, directly contributing to audience growth. I am also proficient in building and maintaining WordPress sites, including content uploads and page updates, ensuring a seamless user experience. My work regularly involves tracking site performance using tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to make data-driven decisions for SEO and content strategies.

What particularly excites me about this opportunity at AppCritica is your focus on AI. My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my proactive engagement with this domain. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, where I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO). This practical experience in technical SEO and Generative Engine Optimization, coupled with proficiency in AI-assisted content tools, positions me uniquely to contribute to AppCritica’s mission.

I am a dedicated professional with a technical foundation in web design and a proven ability to quickly adapt to new tools and platforms. The prospect of working on real projects that impact how businesses and users experience technology worldwide, and learning from industry experts in AI, aligns perfectly with my drive for purposeful growth. I am confident that my skills in content creation, SEO strategy, and understanding of the evolving search landscape, particularly concerning AI, would be a valuable asset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to AppCritica's continued success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
